cohort: The study included 44 postpartum patients who underwent caesarean section at Sufina Aziz Hospital.
finding: The study found a correlation between the intensity of caesarean section wound pain and sleep quality in postpartum patients, with the majority experiencing severe pain and poor sleep quality.
mod_finding: The study focused specifically on postpartum patients who underwent caesarean section, examining wound pain and sleep quality related to this mode of birth.
